issues_found.issue: botShoot derives the projectile origin from `dir` before the trailing dir.normalize(); the offset is ~0.8 units along a near-unit vector (spread + tiny gravity lead), so the spawn point is at most a sliver off and not observable. (stats.slow is undefined for splatter/confetti/petalbow but is correctly defaulted with ?? 0 in the spawn call — no defect.)
issues_found.suggestion: Cosmetic only. Optionally normalize dir before deriving origin. No action required to ship.
